title: Fees and discounts are removed on conversion and not restored
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, with one approved labor line of 2.0 hours, a work order fee of $25.00 and a 10% line discount on the labor line.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
  3. Click "Convert to No Charge".
  4. Pick "Goodwill" in Category.
  5. Click the confirming Convert to No Charge button.
  6. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
  7. Click "Convert to Billable".
  8. Click the confirming Convert to Billable button.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 shows the $25.00 fee and the discount.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows "Convert to No Charge".

Step 3:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 4:

  • Goodwill is picked.

Step 5:

  • The fee and the discount are gone.

Step 6:

  • The menu does not show "Add Work Order Fee / Discount".

Step 7:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 8:

  • The labor line is priced again; the $25.00 fee and the 10% discount do not come back.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R15: “When a work order becomes internal or no charge, its work order fees and discounts and its line discounts are removed with the prices, and "Add Work Order Fee / Discount" is not shown in its menu. Making it billable again prices the lines from the customer's pricing and does not restore removed fees or discounts.”
